title: Introductions
description: Introduce yourself and get someone to open up.

questions.sentence: Aapka naam kya hai?
options: Mera naam {name} hai.
Main Dilli se hoon.
Main theek hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Mera naam {name} hai.
questions.translatedSentence: My name is {name}.

questions.sentence: Main Dilli mein rehta hoon.
options: I live in Delhi.
I am from Delhi.
I am going to Delhi.
questions.correctAnswer: I live in Delhi.

questions.sentence: Aap kahan se hain?
options: Main Jaipur se hoon.
Main student hoon.
Mera naam Rahul hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main Jaipur se hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am from Jaipur.

questions.sentence: Main yahan naya hoon.
options: I am new here.
I live here.
I am here now.
questions.correctAnswer: I am new here.

questions.sentence: Namaste, aap kaise hain?
options: Main theek hoon, dhanyavaad.
Main Lucknow se hoon.
Mujhe chai chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Main theek hoon, dhanyavaad.
questions.translatedSentence: I am fine, thank you.

questions.sentence: Mera ghar Lucknow mein hai.
options: My house is in Lucknow.
My house is very big.
I am going home to Lucknow.
questions.correctAnswer: My house is in Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Aapka shahar kaunsa hai?
options: Mera shahar Jaipur hai.
Mera naam Priya hai.
Main abhi ghar par hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Mera shahar Jaipur hai.
questions.translatedSentence: My city is Jaipur.

questions.sentence: Main Bharat se hoon.
options: I am from India.
I am in India.
I am going to India.
questions.correctAnswer: I am from India.

questions.sentence: Aapse milkar khushi hui.
options: Mujhe bhi khushi hui.
Main Dilli mein hoon.
Aap kahan rehte hain?
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe bhi khushi hui.
questions.translatedSentence: It is nice to meet you too.

questions.sentence: Aapki umar kitni hai?
options: Meri umar pachees saal hai.
Mera naam Anil hai.
Main office mein hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Meri umar pachees saal hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I am twenty-five years old.

questions.sentence: Main ek teacher hoon.
options: I am a teacher.
I am a student.
I want to become a teacher.
questions.correctAnswer: I am a teacher.

questions.sentence: Aap kya kaam karte hain?
options: Main ek doctor hoon.
Main tees saal ka hoon.
Main roz chai peeta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main ek doctor hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am a doctor.

questions.sentence: Main abhi college mein padhta hoon.
options: I am studying in college right now.
I used to study in college.
I want to go to college.
questions.correctAnswer: I am studying in college right now.

questions.sentence: {name}, aap kitne saal ke hain?
options: Main battees saal ka hoon.
Main Jaipur mein rehta hoon.
Mujhe apna kaam pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main battees saal ka hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am thirty-two years old.

questions.sentence: Main ek company mein kaam karta hoon.
options: I work at a company.
I am looking for a job at a company.
I run my own company.
questions.correctAnswer: I work at a company.

questions.sentence: Aap kahan kaam karte hain?
options: Main ek school mein kaam karta hoon.
Main metro se jaata hoon.
Mera kaam bahut achha hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main ek school mein kaam karta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I work at a school.

questions.sentence: Meri behen bhi doctor hai.
options: My sister is a doctor too.
My sister wants to be a doctor.
My sister has gone to the doctor.
questions.correctAnswer: My sister is a doctor too.

questions.sentence: Kya aap abhi padhte hain ya kaam karte hain?
options: Main padhta bhi hoon aur kaam bhi karta hoon.
Haan, main abhi ghar par baitha hoon.
Nahi, mujhe chai nahi chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Main padhta bhi hoon aur kaam bhi karta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I both study and work.

questions.sentence: Aap kaun kaun si bhasha bolte hain?
options: Main Hindi aur Angrezi bolta hoon.
Main Dilli mein padhta hoon.
Mujhe khaana banana aata hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main Hindi aur Angrezi bolta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I speak Hindi and English.

questions.sentence: Mujhe thoda thoda Hindi aati hai.
options: I know just a little Hindi.
I do not know any Hindi.
I speak Hindi very well.
questions.correctAnswer: I know just a little Hindi.

questions.sentence: Kya aap Hindi bolte hain?
options: Haan, lekin bahut kam bolta hoon.
Nahi, main Dilli se hoon.
Haan, main ek teacher hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, lekin bahut kam bolta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but I speak very little.

questions.sentence: Main dheere dheere seekh raha hoon.
options: I am learning slowly.
I have already learned everything.
I want to learn quickly.
questions.correctAnswer: I am learning slowly.

questions.sentence: Aapki Hindi bahut achhi hai.
options: Dhanyavaad, main abhi bhi seekh raha hoon.
Haan, main Angrezi nahi bolta.
Meri umar tees saal hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhanyavaad, main abhi bhi seekh raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, I am still learning.

questions.sentence: Mujhe Angrezi Hindi se aasaan lagti hai.
options: I find English easier than Hindi.
I find English harder than Hindi.
English and Hindi are both easy for me.
questions.correctAnswer: I find English easier than Hindi.

questions.sentence: Kya aap thoda dheere bol sakte hain?
options: Haan zaroor, koi baat nahi.
Nahi, main Hindi nahi bolta.
Haan, main bahut jaldi mein hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan zaroor, koi baat nahi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes of course, no problem.

questions.sentence: Main ghar par sirf Hindi bolta hoon.
options: I speak only Hindi at home.
I speak Hindi outside the house.
We do not speak Hindi at home.
questions.correctAnswer: I speak only Hindi at home.

questions.sentence: Aapne Hindi kahan se seekhi?
options: Maine ise Dilli mein seekha hai.
Main Hindi roz bolta hoon.
Mujhe Hindi bahut pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Maine ise Dilli mein seekha hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I learned it in Delhi.

questions.sentence: Main Lucknow se hoon aur yahan naukri karta hoon.
options: Achha, aap kaun sa kaam karte hain?
Achha, mujhe bahut der ho rahi hai.
Achha, main abhi khaana khaa raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Achha, aap kaun sa kaam karte hain?
questions.translatedSentence: I see, what kind of work do you do?

questions.sentence: Aap yahan kitne saal se rehte hain?
options: How many years have you been living here?
How old are you?
How many people live here?
questions.correctAnswer: How many years have you been living here?

questions.sentence: Aap yahan tak kaise aaye?
options: Main metro se aaya hoon.
Main teen saal se yahan hoon.
Main yahan paas mein kaam karta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main metro se aaya hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I came by metro.

questions.sentence: Aapko yeh shahar kaisa lagta hai?
options: How do you like this city?
Which city are you from?
How far is this city?
questions.correctAnswer: How do you like this city?

questions.sentence: Aapko yahan ka khaana kaisa lagta hai?
options: Mujhe roti sabzi bahut pasand hai.
Main roz auto rickshaw se jaata hoon.
Mera ghar yahan se bahut door hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe roti sabzi bahut pasand hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I really like roti and sabzi.

questions.sentence: Kya aap akele rehte hain ya parivaar ke saath?
options: Do you live alone or with your family?
Do you live here or in Delhi?
Are you going alone or with your family?
questions.correctAnswer: Do you live alone or with your family?

questions.sentence: Main apne parivaar ke saath rehta hoon.
options: Aapke parivaar mein kitne log hain?
Aap kis school mein padhte the?
Aapko chai chahiye ya nahi?
questions.correctAnswer: Aapke parivaar mein kitne log hain?
questions.translatedSentence: How many people are there in your family?

questions.sentence: Aap khaali samay mein kya karte hain?
options: What do you do in your free time?
What do you do for a living?
When do you get free time?
questions.correctAnswer: What do you do in your free time?

questions.sentence: Aapko apne khaali samay mein kya karna pasand hai?
options: Mujhe kitaabein padhna pasand hai.
Mujhe kal subah jaana hai.
Mere do bhai hain.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe kitaabein padhna pasand hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I like reading books.

questions.sentence: Yeh mera dost Rohan hai.
options: Namaste Rohan, aapse milkar achha laga.
Main Rohan ko bilkul nahi jaanta.
Rohan abhi kahan gaya hai?
questions.correctAnswer: Namaste Rohan, aapse milkar achha laga.
questions.translatedSentence: Hello Rohan, it is nice to meet you.

questions.sentence: Yeh meri dost Meera hai, woh Jaipur se hai.
options: This is my friend Meera, she is from Jaipur.
This is my friend Meera, she lives in Jaipur.
My friend Meera has gone to Jaipur.
questions.correctAnswer: This is my friend Meera, she is from Jaipur.

questions.sentence: Aapke saath yeh kaun hain?
options: Yeh meri behen hain, inka naam Anjali hai.
Yeh mera ghar hai, main yahan rehta hoon.
Yeh chai bahut achhi hai, aap bhi lijiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Yeh meri behen hain, inka naam Anjali hai.
questions.translatedSentence: This is my sister, her name is Anjali.

questions.sentence: Hum dono ek hi office mein kaam karte hain.
options: The two of us work at the same office.
The two of us work at different offices.
The two of us used to work at the same office.
questions.correctAnswer: The two of us work at the same office.

questions.sentence: Aap dono ek doosre ko kaise jaante hain?
options: Hum college ke dinon se dost hain.
Hum dono roz saath mein chai peete hain.
Main inhe bilkul nahi jaanta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Hum college ke dinon se dost hain.
questions.translatedSentence: We have been friends since our college days.

questions.sentence: Meri patni Angrezi padhaati hain, lekin unhe Hindi bhi aati hai.
options: My wife teaches English, but she knows Hindi as well.
My wife teaches Hindi, but she knows English as well.
My wife is studying English, but she wants to learn Hindi.
questions.correctAnswer: My wife teaches English, but she knows Hindi as well.

questions.sentence: Inse miliye, yeh mere bhai hain aur Dilli mein doctor hain.
options: Namaste, maine aapke baare mein bahut suna hai.
Namaste, mujhe kal doctor ke paas jaana hai.
Namaste, mujhe abhi nikalna hoga.
questions.correctAnswer: Namaste, maine aapke baare mein bahut suna hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Hello, I have heard a lot about you.

questions.sentence: Woh abhi nahi aa sakte, kyunki unka kaam khatam nahi hua hai.
options: He cannot come right now, because his work is not finished.
He will not come at all, because he has no work.
He came late, because his work was not finished.
questions.correctAnswer: He cannot come right now, because his work is not finished.

questions.sentence: Aapke dost kya kaam karte hain?
options: Woh ek school mein padhaate hain.
Woh mere saath hi rehte the.
Woh pichhle saal Jaipur gaye the.
questions.correctAnswer: Woh ek school mein padhaate hain.
questions.translatedSentence: He teaches at a school.

questions.sentence: Aapse milkar bahut achha laga, kya hum phir mil sakte hain?
options: Haan zaroor, agle hafte milte hain.
Nahi, mujhe yahan achha nahi laga.
Haan, main abhi ghar ja raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan zaroor, agle hafte milte hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes of course, let us meet next week.

questions.sentence: Kya aap mujhe apna phone number de sakte hain?
options: Could you give me your phone number?
Can I call you on the phone?
Do you have my phone number?
questions.correctAnswer: Could you give me your phone number?

questions.sentence: Main aapko apna number bhej deta hoon, lekin abhi mera phone band hai.
options: Koi baat nahi, aap baad mein bhej dijiye.
Theek hai, main aapka phone le leta hoon.
Maaf kijiye, mere paas phone nahi hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahi, aap baad mein bhej dijiye.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem, please send it later.

questions.sentence: Agar aapko waqt mile to mujhe message kar dijiyega.
options: If you get some time, please send me a message.
When I get some time, I will send you a message.
I did not get the time to send you a message.
questions.correctAnswer: If you get some time, please send me a message.

questions.sentence: Kya aap WhatsApp par rehte hain?
options: Haan, main wahin sabse zyada active rehta hoon.
Nahi, mera phone bilkul naya hai.
Haan, mujhe message padhna pasand nahi hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, main wahin sabse zyada active rehta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am most active there.

questions.sentence: Main aapko kal shaam ko phone karunga, kyunki abhi main kaam par hoon.
options: I will call you tomorrow evening, because I am at work right now.
I called you yesterday evening, because I was at work.
I cannot call you tomorrow evening, because I have work.
questions.correctAnswer: I will call you tomorrow evening, because I am at work right now.

questions.sentence: Mujhe ab nikalna hoga, warna meri metro chhoot jayegi.
options: Theek hai, sambhal kar jaaiye, phir baat karte hain.
Theek hai, main aapke saath auto rickshaw le leta hoon.
Theek hai, lekin main abhi tak nikla nahi hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Theek hai, sambhal kar jaaiye, phir baat karte hain.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, travel safe, we will talk again.

questions.sentence: Aapse baat karke bahut achha laga, lekin ab mujhe chalna chahiye.
options: It was really nice talking to you, but I should get going now.
It was nice talking to you, but I do not want to leave.
I will talk to you properly once I get there.
questions.correctAnswer: It was really nice talking to you, but I should get going now.

questions.sentence: Phir milenge, apna khayal rakhiyega.
options: Aap bhi apna khayal rakhiye, jald hi milte hain.
Main aapka khayal nahi rakh sakta.
Haan, mujhe kal hi jaana tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Aap bhi apna khayal rakhiye, jald hi milte hain.
questions.translatedSentence: You take care too, let us meet again soon.
